// Real-world AsciiDoc CSR body block whose `Reset value` cell
// carries a SYMBOLIC token (`DEFINED, ...`) rather than a numeric
// literal. Synthetic minimal `0x00000000` fixture does NOT exercise
// this — that gap caused #399 R1 (v1.6.589 walker correctly
// classified kind but merge layer cherry-picked specific keys and
// dropped reset_value_kind).
//
// Use in test:
//   src = load_real_fixture("csr_body_block_with_symbolic_reset.adoc")
//   out = _v1_6_491_extract_csr_definitions(src, "f.adoc")
//   assert out[0]["reset_value"] == "DEFINED"
//   assert out[0]["reset_value_kind"] == "symbolic"

===== **`ext_isa_select`**

[cols="<1,<8"]
|=======================
| Name        | ISA and extensions
| Address     | `0x301`
| Reset value | `DEFINED`, according to enabled ISA extensions
| ISA         | <<_zicsr_isa_extension,`Zicsr`>>
| Description | Reports which ISA extensions are implemented at this
                hart. Bits are read-only and pre-set at synthesis.
|=======================
